- **Southwest** has no separately reported regional/capacity-purchase expense line; peers push large amounts of regional labor into "regional carriers expense" rather than salaries, wages and benefits, which inflates Southwest's labor ratio in a direct comparison.
- All five companies use a December 31 fiscal year end, so there is no fiscal-period mismatch.
